title: Physics-guided vs data-only flow matching on a synthetic advection-diffusion field
setting: An 8x8 periodic field evolves under advection-diffusion with a spatially varying wind, plus a term the PDE omits (a fixed pattern, a linear damping, a mild nonlinearity) and small noise. A small MLP conditional flow-matching model is trained for 300 Adam steps to generate the next field from noise, conditioned on the current field. The physics-guided variant blends a PDE-driven velocity with the network velocity through a learned per-cell gate. The metric is RMSE of the sample-averaged forecast against fresh held-out true trajectories, at a 1-step or 3-step autoregressive horizon.

paper.title: Physics-Guided Flow Matching: A Generative AI Framework for Global Total Electron Content Forecasting
paper.claim: Adding PDE-based physical guidance with an adaptive per-location weighting to flow matching lowers forecast RMSE compared with the same flow-matching framework without physical guidance.

metric.name: rmse
metric.description: RMSE between the averaged generated forecast and the true field at the final horizon step on 100 held-out initial states. Diagnostics: rmse_pde_only and rmse_persistence (non-learned references), gate_mean and gate_row_range (learned gate; 0 for data_only).

factors.name: method
factors.description: data_only: flow matching on a linear noise-to-next-field path with an MLP velocity. pgfm: the same MLP, with the velocity blended per cell with a PDE-driven velocity toward the PDE step, using a jointly learned gate.

factors.name: pde
factors.description: Fidelity of the PDE used for guidance: exact wind and diffusion, wind scaled by 1.3, or advection omitted entirely (diffusion only).

factors.name: horizon
factors.description: Forecast lead in steps; 3 uses autoregressive rollout of the mean forecast.
